records.context: A shared line ruler that measures image coordinates without changing pixels.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler#0
records.source: A shared line ruler that measures image coordinates without changing pixels.
records.translation: Uma régua de linha compartilhada que mede coordenadas da imagem sem alterar pixels.

records.context: Keep a line in image pixels and paint it through the host's transform.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler#0
records.source: Keep a line in image pixels and paint it through the host's transform.
records.translation: Mantém uma linha em pixels da imagem e a desenha usando a transformação do componente hospedeiro.

records.context: owning image canvas or view; defaults to None.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler#1
records.source: owning image canvas or view; defaults to None.
records.translation: tela ou visualização de imagem proprietária; o padrão é None.

records.context: Hosts pass their widget-to-image mapping to :meth:`handle` and inverse mapping to :meth:`paint`. Zoom and pan never change the measured length. Pixel units are always shown. Physical units require explicit, validated calibration through :meth:`set_spacing`; camera magnification is never guessed. Right-click clears while the tool is active. Start with no line, no calibration and drawing disabled.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler#2
records.source: Hosts pass their widget-to-image mapping to :meth:`handle` and inverse mapping to :meth:`paint`. Zoom and pan never change the measured length. Pixel units are always shown. Physical units require explicit, validated calibration through :meth:`set_spacing`; camera magnification is never guessed. Right-click clears while the tool is active. Start with no line, no calibration and drawing disabled.
records.translation: Os componentes hospedeiros passam seu mapeamento de widget para imagem a :meth:`handle` e o mapeamento inverso a :meth:`paint`. Zoom e deslocamento nunca alteram o comprimento medido. Unidades em pixels são sempre exibidas. Unidades físicas exigem calibração explícita e validada por :meth:`set_spacing`; a ampliação da câmera nunca é presumida. O clique direito apaga a linha enquanto a ferramenta está ativa. O estado inicial não tem linha nem calibração e mantém o desenho desativado.

records.context: Remove the line without changing tool activation or calibration.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.clear#0
records.source: Remove the line without changing tool activation or calibration.
records.translation: Remove a linha sem alterar a ativação da ferramenta ou a calibração.

records.context: None; emits ``changed`` even when no line was present.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.clear#1
records.source: None; emits ``changed`` even when no line was present.
records.translation: None; emite ``changed`` mesmo quando não havia linha.

records.source: Consume ruler mouse gestures; return False for navigation gestures.
records.translation: Processa os gestos de mouse da régua; retorna False para gestos de navegação.

records.context: a mouse press, move or release from the host canvas.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.handle#1
records.source: a mouse press, move or release from the host canvas.
records.translation: evento de pressionar, mover ou soltar o mouse na tela hospedeira.

records.context: widget QPointF -> image (x, y), or None off-image.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.handle#2
records.source: widget QPointF -> image (x, y), or None off-image.
records.translation: QPointF do widget -> imagem (x, y), ou None fora da imagem.

records.context: True for consumed ruler gestures; False when the host should handle the event. Coordinates outside the image do not move endpoints.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.handle#3
records.source: True for consumed ruler gestures; False when the host should handle the event. Coordinates outside the image do not move endpoints.
records.translation: True para gestos da régua processados; False quando o hospedeiro deve tratar o evento. Coordenadas fora da imagem não movem os pontos finais.

records.context: Return pixel length and, only when calibrated, physical length.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.label#0
records.source: Return pixel length and, only when calibrated, physical length.
records.translation: Retorna o comprimento em pixels e, somente quando calibrado, o comprimento físico.

records.context: text with lengths to two decimal places; empty before a line exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.label#1
records.source: text with lengths to two decimal places; empty before a line exists.
records.translation: texto com comprimentos em duas casas decimais; vazio antes de existir uma linha.

records.context: Return the line length, or None before a line exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.length#0
records.source: Return the line length, or None before a line exists.
records.translation: Retorna o comprimento da linha, ou None antes de existir uma linha.

records.context: False (default) uses image pixels; True uses calibrated per-axis spacing, including different horizontal and vertical values.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.length#1
records.source: False (default) uses image pixels; True uses calibrated per-axis spacing, including different horizontal and vertical values.
records.translation: False (padrão) usa pixels da imagem; True usa o espaçamento calibrado de cada eixo, incluindo valores horizontais e verticais diferentes.

records.context: Euclidean length as a float in pixels or ``unit``; None when no line exists or physical length is requested without calibration.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.image_ruler.ImageRuler.length#2
records.source: Euclidean length as a float in pixels or ``unit``; None when no line exists or physical length is requested without calibration.
records.translation: comprimento euclidiano como float em pixels ou ``unit``; None quando não existe linha ou é solicitado comprimento físico sem calibração.

records.source: image (x, y) -> widget QPointF or QPoint, or None.

records.source: Set physical distance per image pixel, or clear calibration.

records.source: positive finite distance per vertical image pixel in ``unit``; defaults to None, which uses ``x`` for both axes.
records.translation: distância positiva e finita por pixel vertical da imagem em ``unit``; o padrão é None, que usa ``x`` para ambos os eixos.

records.context: The ten tools, in :data:`TOOL_MODES` order, because this vocabulary is what a reader needs before opening the application view:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#2
records.source: THE TEN TOOLS, in :data:`TOOL_MODES` order, because this vocabulary is what a reader needs before opening the screen:
records.translation: AS DEZ FERRAMENTAS, na ordem de :data:`TOOL_MODES`, pois esse vocabulário é necessário antes de abrir a tela:

records.context: **Ruler** is the tenth. Drag between image pixels to read a length without editing labels. Zoom and pan preserve it; right-click with Ruler selected clears it. The same ruler is available on the paired live preview canvases.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#5
records.source: **Ruler** is the tenth. Drag between image pixels to read a length without editing labels. Zoom and pan preserve it; right-click with Ruler selected clears it. The same ruler is available on the paired live preview canvases.
records.translation: **Régua** é a décima ferramenta. Arraste entre pixels da imagem para ler um comprimento sem editar rótulos. Zoom e deslocamento o preservam; um clique direito com Régua selecionada o apaga. A mesma régua está disponível nas telas de prévia ao vivo emparelhadas.

records.context: Editor modes are assembled from :func:`tool_row_entries` and :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` inserts non-mode actions into the same toolbar. The settings panel carries the operations that are not gestures -- object filling and relabeling, swapping object and background, size filtering and Otsu detection, with undo and redo over all of them -- alongside the brush, wand and display controls, and can be hidden to return its width to the canvas.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#8
records.source: Editor modes are assembled from :func:`tool_row_entries` and :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` inserts non-mode actions into the same toolbar. The settings panel carries the operations that are not gestures -- object filling and relabeling, swapping object and background, size filtering and Otsu detection, with undo and redo over all of them -- alongside the brush, wand and display controls, and can be hidden to return its width to the canvas.
records.translation: Os modos do editor são montados a partir de :func:`tool_row_entries` e :data:`TOOL_MODES`. :meth:`MakeMasksScreen.add_toolbar_action` insere ações que não são modos na mesma barra de ferramentas. O painel de configurações contém as operações que não são gestos —preenchimento e nova rotulagem de objetos, troca de objeto e fundo, filtragem por tamanho e detecção Otsu, todas com desfazer e refazer— junto dos controles de pincel, varinha e visualização. Ele pode ser ocultado para devolver sua largura à tela de imagem.

records.context: Image inversion and swapping object and background are separate operations. The first changes the image seen by the detector; the second changes labels.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#9
records.source: Image inversion and swapping object and background are separate operations. The first changes the image seen by the detector; the second changes labels.
records.translation: A inversão da imagem e a troca de objeto e fundo são operações separadas. A primeira altera a imagem vista pelo detector; a segunda altera os rótulos.

records.context: **Invert image**, in the Display category, is THE inversion. It draws the microscope field of view as its own negative and hands the detectors that same negative: both detect buttons and the live magnifier segment :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, so a threshold written for bright objects takes dark ones, and a banner above the image says so for as long as it is on. The corner readout's pixel intensity follows the inverted image. Object mean intensities and the object filter still read the loaded pixels. Saving writes label masks without changing the source image.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#10
records.source: **Invert image**, in the Display category, is THE inversion. It draws the field as its own negative and hands the detectors that same negative: both detect buttons and the live magnifier segment :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, so a threshold written for bright objects takes dark ones, and a banner above the image says so for as long as it is on. The corner readout's pixel intensity follows the inverted image. Object mean intensities and the object filter still read the loaded pixels. Saving writes label masks without changing the source image.
records.translation: **Inverter imagem**, na categoria Visualização, é a inversão comum. Ela desenha o campo como seu negativo e fornece o mesmo negativo aos detectores: ambos os botões de detecção e a lupa ao vivo segmentam :meth:`MakeMasksScreen._detector_image`, de modo que um limiar definido para objetos claros detecte os escuros. Um aviso acima da imagem indica isso enquanto estiver ativo. A intensidade do pixel na leitura do canto acompanha a imagem invertida. As intensidades médias dos objetos e o filtro de objetos continuam lendo os pixels carregados. Ao salvar, são gravadas máscaras de rótulos sem alterar a imagem de origem.

records.context: It used to be two switches and they could disagree. A display-only "Invert image" drew a negative and left detection untouched; "Invert for detection" inverted what the detectors read and drew nothing. A curator could hold either without the other, and the first one's status line had to contradict the second one's banner. They are one switch because the reason for the switch is one intention: inverting a microscope field of view of dark objects so that Otsu and the magnifier can detect them. ``_cp_invert`` is now the same widget object as ``_invert_display`` under its old name, so the two cannot come apart.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#11
records.source: IT USED TO BE TWO SWITCHES AND THEY COULD DISAGREE. A display-only "Invert image" drew a negative and left detection untouched; "Invert for detection" inverted what the detectors read and drew nothing. A curator could hold either without the other, and the first one's status line had to contradict the second one's banner. They are one switch because the reason for the switch is one intention: inverting a field of dark objects so that Otsu and the magnifier can detect them. ``_cp_invert`` is now the same widget object as ``_invert_display`` under its old name, so the two cannot come apart.
records.translation: ANTES HAVIA DOIS CONTROLES QUE PODIAM SE CONTRADIZER. Um "Invert image" (Inverter imagem) limitado à exibição desenhava um negativo sem alterar a detecção; "Invert for detection" (Inverter para detecção) invertia a entrada dos detectores sem desenhar nada. Era possível ativar um sem o outro, e a linha de status do primeiro podia contradizer o aviso do segundo. Agora há um único controle porque a intenção é uma: inverter um campo de objetos escuros para que Otsu e a lupa possam detectá-los. ``_cp_invert`` agora é o mesmo objeto widget que ``_invert_display`` sob seu nome antigo, portanto os dois não podem divergir.

records.context: **Swap object and background**, in Object operations, is the old "Invert mask" under the name that describes it -- it flips the LABEL image, which on an ordinary microscope field of view leaves one object covering the frame. It is not a picture invert and is deliberately not called one.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#12
records.source: **Swap object and background**, in Object operations, is the old "Invert mask" under the name that describes it -- it flips the LABEL image, which on an ordinary field leaves one object covering the frame. It is not a picture invert and is deliberately not called one.
records.translation: **Trocar objeto e fundo**, em Operações de objetos, é o antigo "Invert mask" (Inverter máscara) com um nome descritivo: inverte a imagem de RÓTULOS, o que em um campo comum deixa um objeto cobrindo todo o quadro. Não é uma inversão de imagem e deliberadamente não recebe esse nome.

records.context: The arithmetic. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` normalises the microscope field of view to 0..1 on its own range and takes ``1 - v``, and the normalisation is not incidental: the Otsu correction is a MULTIPLIER on an absolute level, so normalising first is what makes one correction value mean the same thing on the next image. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (dtype complement) and :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (reflection about the microscope field of view's range) are what this application view used before and are kept for other callers. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` flips labels.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#13
records.source: THE ARITHMETIC. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` normalises the field to 0..1 on its own range and takes ``1 - v``, and the normalisation is not incidental: the Otsu correction is a MULTIPLIER on an absolute level, so normalising first is what makes one correction value mean the same thing on the next image. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (dtype complement) and :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (reflection about the field's range) are what this screen used before and are kept for other callers. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` flips labels.
records.translation: O CÁLCULO. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_normalized` normaliza o campo para 0..1 com base em seu próprio intervalo e calcula ``1 - v``. A normalização é importante: a correção Otsu é um MULTIPLICADOR de um nível absoluto, portanto normalizar primeiro faz com que um valor de correção tenha o mesmo significado na imagem seguinte. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_intensity` (complemento do tipo de dados) e :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_for_detection` (reflexão em torno do intervalo do campo) eram usadas anteriormente nesta tela e são mantidas para outros chamadores. :func:`~spacr.qt.mask_engine.invert_mask` inverte rótulos.

review_kind: AI-assisted linguistic and technical review of ruler units, per-axis calibration, defaults and return values, and changed Make Masks introductory paragraphs; no native-speaker sign-off. Eight unchanged paragraphs are retained from the prior catalog and are not claimed as newly reviewed.
